decision_conditions: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

<p>Notwithstanding any hereby approved plans and documents, prior to occupation, further details of the proposed refuse storage, including screening enclosures, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to confirm an acceptable level of provision (waste, recycling and food caddy). The waste and recycling storage shall then be implemented in accordance with these approved details, and retained thereafter. The refuse and waste bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, within the thereby approved designated refuse storage area</p>

<p>Notwithstanding any hereby approved plans and documents, prior to occupation, revised details for the proposed location of 446a Eastcote Lane’s cycling storage shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The cycling storage shall then be implemented in accordance with these approved details and the PedalBase, and retained thereafter. The refuse and waste bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, within the thereby approved designated refuse storage area</p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until the private outdoor amenity space and soft landscaping as shown under approved plan reference 446EL/100 Rev B - Existing &amp; Proposed Site Block &amp; Site Location Plans, has been provided. The development shall operate in accordance with these approved details thereafter, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority</p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><p>446EL/100 Rev B - Existing &amp; Proposed Site Block &amp; Site Location Plans (received 06.02.24); 446EL/101 - Existing Floor Plans; 446EL/102 - Existing Elevations; 446EL/103 Rev A- Proposed Floor Plans (received 06.02.24); 446EL/104 – Proposed Elevations; Design and Access Statement by Manu Design; Reasonable Exception Statement (received 19.12.24); Cycle Storage Details – PedalBase range (received 06.01.25)</p><p>All documents received and valid on 17.12.24, unless otherwise stated</p>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
<p>The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved Fire Safety Reasonable Exception Statement (received 19.12.24) by Manu Design.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved documents, the development hereby approved shall not be first occupied until revised details active and passive electric vehicle charging points have been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority in accordance with London Plan standards. The arrangements so agreed shall be put in place prior to the first occupation of the units hereby approved and shall thereafter be retained.&nbsp;</p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until details of boundary treatment between the rear gardens of the houses has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The approved details shall be implemented on site prior to the approved houses being first occupied and retained thereafter.</p><p>&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
description: Conversion of single dwellinghouse into two dwellings (2 x 2 beds); front entrance porch; parking; bin storage; extended vehicle access; external alterations; (demolition of front porch)
